proposals.before: On bingchen Tang Rui, adjutant of the Tianxiong Army, was made Remonstrance Counsellor; Zhao Tong, chief secretary, became Remending Officer; and Song Lingxun, chief military aide from the Emperor's original entourage, was made prefect of Cizhou.
proposals.after: On bingchen Tang Rui, adjutant of the Tianxiong Army, was made Remonstrance Counsellor; Zhao Tuan, chief secretary, became Gentleman of the Imperial Diary; and Song Lingxun, chief military aide from the Emperor's original entourage, was made prefect of Cizhou.
proposals.reason: 趙彖 is Zhao Tuan, not Zhao Tong; 起居郎 is the court diarist, not a 'Remending Officer'.

proposals.before: On dingchou Cui Jujian, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Secretariat; Zhang Jizuo, former prefect of Cai, was made General of the Left Martial Guard and appointed deputy commissioner for imperial tomb bridges, roads, and relay stations.

proposals.reason: 秘書監 is the Palace Library director, not the Secretariat; the same chapter later renders 秘書監 as Director of the Palace Library.

proposals.before: On wuyin he took the Hall of Bright Hall with guards and escort as prescribed, palace music was played, and the ministers in court dress took their places. An edict proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the fifth year of Changxing to the first year of Yingshun.
proposals.after: On wuyin he took the Mingtang Hall with guards and escort as prescribed, palace music was played, and the ministers in court dress took their places. An edict proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the fifth year of Changxing to the first year of Yingshun.
proposals.reason: 明堂殿 is the Mingtang (Bright Hall); 'Hall of Bright Hall' doubles the building word.

proposals.before: On wuyin he took the Hall of Bright Hall; guards and escort followed the rite, palace suspended music was played, the ministers took their places in court dress, and an edict proclaimed a general amnesty for all under heaven, changing the fifth year of Changxing to the first year of Yingshun.
proposals.after: On wuyin he took the Mingtang Hall; guards and escort followed the rite, palace suspended music was played, the ministers took their places in court dress, and an edict proclaimed a general amnesty for all under heaven, changing the fifth year of Changxing to the first year of Yingshun.
proposals.reason: Same doubled rendering of 明堂殿.
